The cricket

Real grounds, real formats, real pressure

Where they play

A different ground most days, and conditions nothing like home — different pitches, different pace, different heat, against players who grew up on them.

How it is played

Twelve teams — local Trinidadian and Tobagonian sides plus other touring squads. T20 qualifiers, then a 50-over competition, then finals day. Umpired, live scored and streamed.

The grounds

Six grounds, one island

Tobago is 26 miles long, and the squad sees most of it getting to them.

Live scoring & streaming

Open it on your phone

The GCS Tour App runs the whole tournament — and it is live right now with the 2026 results.

  • Fixtures, live scores and full scorecards
  • Group standings and player statistics
  • Every match streamed live
  • Players’ Player of the Tournament voting
  • Free for every player and every family

The island

And then there is the rest of it

Reef trip, goat racing, steel pan, an Old Time Wedding, a beach barbecue — all supervised at match-day staff ratios.

Ten days

They go as strangers — and you can come too

The players

Squads are drawn from different clubs and different schools, so nobody arrives knowing everyone. Pre-tour training and a team-building day before you fly, staff with them around the clock, and full tour kit, named and numbered.

The families

Supporters travel on the same tour — same island, same fixtures, their own itinerary. If you cannot travel, you watch every match on the app from home.
